summary: PTC Therapeutics filed an 8-K reporting the completion of a $550 million private offering of 0.0% Convertible Senior Notes due 2031, including full exercise of the initial purchasers' $50 million option. The notes were sold to QIBs under Rule 144A via Morgan Stanley as lead initial purchaser. They mature June 15, 2031, carry no regular interest (only special interest for reporting/tradeability failures), and are convertible at 9.3042 shares per $1,000 principal (initial conversion price ~$107.48/share). This is a capital-raising financing and does not constitute a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, or strategic change is involved.
